annotations.title: Edit the caption of a published post

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] CHANGES THE CAPTION OF A POST THAT IS ALREADY LIVE on real accounts, in place (same post, likes and comments stay). Works on Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, Google Business and Telegram; Instagram, TikTok, Threads and X do not allow it (listed in `skipped`). Pass `text` (every platform) and/or `platformText` ({ linkedin: "…" }); `platforms` limits it to some platforms; `dryRun: true` shows the plan and sends nothing. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"edit_live_caption"}.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

acknowledgeAds.description: Format: boolean; e.g. false. LIVE post only: go ahead although a running boost / ad uses the post (Meta re-reviews the ad).

dryRun.description: Format: boolean; e.g. false. With `switchAccounts` on a post held for review: preview the switch (status "would_switch"), nothing written.

id.description: Format: string; e.g. "id_123". The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

placeholderOverride.description: Format: string; e.g. "Example". LIVE post only: why a caption that looks like an internal note (e.g. "[cut 3] …") is really meant.

platforms.description: Format: array; e.g. ["instagram"]. LIVE post only: edit the caption on these platforms only (each must be live on the post).

text.description: Format: string; e.g. "Discover our new collection.". The caption (every platform without its own).

name: edit_live_caption
title: Edit the caption of a published post
